LS78.en: First grey light on the massive vermilion gate of a palace, an immense orderly structure about to be struck, a heavy iron hammer resting in the foreground, cold pre-dawn palette, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS78.beat: 秩序大厦即将迎来最血腥的一记重锤

PA02.en: A narrow dark gate passage at night, rows of armored men standing motionless in deep shadow, only helmet rims and shoulder plates catching faint torchlight, dust in the air, cold blue tones, wide low-angle shot, photorealistic, cinematic.
PA02.beat: 门洞幽暗阴影里静立的甲士群像

LS77.en: Nine warhorses tethered in a dark stable, wooden bits wedged in their mouths, hooves wrapped in thick hemp cloth, a groom's hand silencing one, single lantern, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS77.beat: 九匹战马塞木棍裹麻布

LS27.en: A young prince in battered black armor standing amid the aftermath of a battlefield at dusk, torn banners, fallen men and horses, exhausted but unbroken, cold blue-grey light, photorealistic, cinematic.

PA05.en: A young Tang dynasty commander standing alone in an empty stone courtyard before dawn, armor dark with cold light, hands clasped behind his back, high walls pressing in on all sides, low fog at his feet, medium-wide shot from behind, photorealistic, cinematic.
PA05.beat: 绝境中的统帅：体制铁壁下的孤影

LS61.en: Transfer orders being issued in a ministry while steppe raid smoke rises on the northern horizon beyond the window, dusk, cold administrative light against distant fire, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS61.beat: 借突厥寇边之名调动天策府兵将

PA07.en: An emptied military camp at dusk, bare tent frames, weapon racks picked clean, cooking pots overturned, dust hanging in low light, a single empty saddle on the ground, wide desolate shot, photorealistic, cinematic.
PA07.beat: 被抽空的军营，兵甲尽去

LS65.en: A prince alone at a board game with every piece already lost, three scrolls of legitimate procedure beside him, low dusk light, defeat rendered without violence, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS65.beat: 论名分论行政论后援，全输光

LS69.en: A mid-ranking guard commander in the livery of the Eastern Palace standing watch at a heavy northern palace gate in freezing November wind, face unreadable, frost on the gate studs, photorealistic, cinematic.

LS71.en: A folded-edge steel gold-inlaid blade and several open chests of gold ingots on a plain table in a lamplit room, the light warm on metal, the recipient's hand hovering, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS71.beat: 折刃金刀与几箱沉甸甸的黄金

LS72.en: Close-up in darkness of an iron lock being replaced on a massive vermilion palace gate, a hand withdrawing a new key, moonlight edge, silence, photorealistic, cinematic.

LS73.en: A palace courtyard of grey brick after rain, still puddles mirroring a cold waning moon, black rooflines, absolute quiet before dawn, blue-black night, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS73.beat: 雨停，青砖积水倒映残月

PA13.en: Two Tang dynasty princes riding side by side on horseback through a great stone gate at dawn, silk robes under light armor, a few attendants trailing behind, wet flagstones reflecting grey light, medium shot from the front, photorealistic, cinematic.
PA13.beat: 两骑并辔穿过瓮城，蹄声清脆

PA14.en: Close-up of a Tang crown prince hauling back hard on the reins, horse rearing on its hind legs, face taut with sudden alarm, grey dawn light on wet stone, motion blur on the hooves, photorealistic, cinematic.
PA14.beat: 李建成猛勒缰绳，战马人立

PA15.en: Guards standing on a Tang palace gate tower silhouetted against pale dawn sky, hands resting on sword hilts, faces in shadow, no one bowing, cold still air, low-angle shot from below the wall, photorealistic, cinematic.
PA15.beat: 城楼守卒背光而立，手按刀柄

PA16.en: A flock of startled birds bursting upward from a Tang palace corner tower into a grey dawn sky, wings catching first light, roof tiles below, wide shot looking up, photorealistic, cinematic.
PA16.beat: 宿鸟被杀机惊动，腾空扑向长空

PA17.en: A horse wheeling violently on wet flagstones in a Tang palace courtyard at first light, rider leaning into the turn, hooves scraping sparks, empty gateway behind, wide action shot with motion blur, photorealistic, cinematic.
PA17.beat: 战马腾空回转，向宫外狂奔

PB01.en: A Tang dynasty prince in black lamellar armor charging forward on horseback, bow raised, dark cloak streaming behind, dawn mist, palace corridor in the background, low angle tracking shot, photorealistic, cinematic.
PB01.beat: 李世民单骑暴冲而出，引弓搭箭

PB02.en: Extreme close-up of a fully drawn composite bow at dawn, bowstring taut against the archer's cheek, arrowhead catching pale light, breath fogging in cold air, shallow depth of field, photorealistic, cinematic.
PB02.beat: 弓弦拉满如月，箭簇寒光

PB03.en: An arrow in mid-flight streaking through cold dawn mist across a Tang palace courtyard, fletching spinning, motes of fog swirling in its wake, high-speed capture, photorealistic, cinematic.
PB03.beat: 破甲箭穿破晨雾的刹那

PB04.en: A fallen Tang crown prince lying on rain-soaked stone beside the edge of a muddy pool, robes dark with water, court attendants frozen at a distance, grey dawn light, wide still shot, photorealistic, cinematic.

PB05.en: A chaotic Tang palace courtyard in early morning: scattered horses, dropped banners, attendants running in confusion, dust and mist mixing, wide documentary-style shot, photorealistic, cinematic.
PB05.beat: 现场骤然失控，人马交错混乱

PB06.en: A Tang prince on a galloping horse twisting in the saddle to loose arrows backward, reins in his teeth, quiver emptying, blurred palace walls rushing past, motion-heavy medium shot, photorealistic, cinematic.
PB06.beat: 李元吉马背反手连射三箭

PB07.en: A riderless horse breaking from a stone path into a dense grove at dawn, branches whipping past, dust and leaves flying, camera panning hard, photorealistic, cinematic.
PB07.beat: 李世民战马受惊，暴冲入密林

PB08.en: A thick low branch filling the frame as a rider is thrown backward, leaves bursting apart, cold light breaking through the canopy, high-speed wide shot, photorealistic, cinematic.
PB08.beat: 横生粗枝迎面击中胸口

PB09.en: A Tang prince fallen on his back in thick mud at the edge of a grove, armor streaked, chest heaving, one hand braced against the ground, cold dawn light, high-angle shot from above, photorealistic, cinematic.
PB09.beat: 李世民被抽落马下，重摔泥泞

PB10.en: Two figures struggling in deep mud, seen from a distance through reeds, silhouetted against pale morning light, water splashing, faces not visible, wide tense shot, photorealistic, cinematic.
PB10.beat: 泥浆中的扭打（远景剪影）

PB11.en: Extreme close-up of muddy water rippling across a fallen man's face, half submerged, grey light fracturing on the surface, drowned sound implied, shallow depth of field, photorealistic, cinematic.
PB11.beat: 泥水漫过面颊，一线生死

PB12.en: A massive black-armored Tang general reining in hard at the treeline, long lance in hand, mouth open in a shout, dust rising around the horse, dawn light behind him, dramatic low-angle shot, photorealistic, cinematic.
PB12.beat: 尉迟敬德拍马赶到，当空暴喝

PB13.en: A long lance driven forward past a stone palace wall, rider leaning into the thrust, dust and spray flying, motion blur on the shaft, wide action shot, photorealistic, cinematic.

PB14.en: A quiet stone stairway before a Tang palace hall in full morning light, two fallen figures covered by dark cloth at a distance, attendants standing far back, stillness after violence, wide composed shot, photorealistic, cinematic.
PB14.beat: 天色大白，石阶上沉寂的遗体（覆布远景）

PC01.en: Dust and smoke rising beyond a Tang palace wall, soldiers massing in the distance, banners moving, cold morning light, wide establishing shot, photorealistic, cinematic.
PC01.beat: 玄武门外烟尘腾起，风暴逼近

PC02.en: A dense column of Tang palace guards charging across open ground toward a great gate, spears leveled, dust billowing, morning light flaring, wide tracking shot, photorealistic, cinematic.
PC02.beat: 两千东宫卫队悍不畏死反扑宫门

PC03.en: A massive timber ram striking against iron-bound gate doors, wood splintering, dust bursting from the seam, soldiers braced behind it, low angle close on the gate, photorealistic, cinematic.
PC03.beat: 巨木撞击包铁城门，门轴震颤

PC04.en: A Tang officer standing before a closed gate shouting upward, arms thrown wide, helmet pushed back, dust in the air around him, morning light behind, medium shot from the side, photorealistic, cinematic.

PC05.en: Interior of a Tang princely residence in morning light, women and small children gathered in an inner hall, servants standing watch at the doors, tense stillness, oblique wide shot, photorealistic, cinematic.
PC05.beat: 秦王府内，王妃与幼子家眷

PC06.en: A Tang general's hand closing around a rolled order beside a bronze tiger tally on a lacquered table, cold window light, extreme close-up, photorealistic, cinematic.
PC06.beat: 冷酷决断：唯以事实斩断战火

PC07.en: A Tang gate tower parapet seen from below, soldiers on the wall, banners hanging limp, an empty stretch of wall top deliberately out of focus, cold noon light, low angle shot, photorealistic, cinematic. (no gore, no visible remains)
PC07.beat: 城楼女墙（悬示场面以留白处理，不出现血腥物）

PC08.en: Weapons lying scattered on trampled ground, spears and shields abandoned in dust, soldiers walking away in ones and twos, banners trailing, wide noon shot, photorealistic, cinematic.
PC08.beat: 兵器落地，两千精锐如潮溃散

PC09.en: A royal pleasure barge drifting on a misty palace lake at midday, water rippling, pavilions on the far shore, dense fog, wide serene shot with an undertone of confinement, photorealistic, cinematic.
PC09.beat: 海池水波微澜，御舟孤浮晨雾中

PC10.en: A closed sluice gate mechanism on a palace water channel, chains drawn tight, still dark water beyond, cold stone and iron, close-up, photorealistic, cinematic.
PC10.beat: 水闸被控，李渊被困孤舟

LS35.en: A young victor in gilded chainmail walking through the Vermilion Bird Gate, and above on the gate tower the aging emperor gripping the rail with visibly damp palms, the two men's eyes not meeting, bright but uneasy daylight, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS35.beat: 黄金锁子甲踏进朱雀门，老皇帝手心冷汗

PC12.en: A black-armored Tang general standing on a boat deck holding a long lance upright, armor streaked with dust, feet planted, water and mist behind him, low angle from the deck, photorealistic, cinematic.
PC12.beat: 尉迟敬德倒提长槊，立舟不退

PC13.en: Extreme close-up of a long lance butt resting firmly on wooden boat deck planks, a black-gauntleted hand steady around the shaft, water reflections on the wood, oblique close shot, photorealistic, cinematic.
PC13.beat: “宿卫”二字重逾千钧的通牒（以按槊的手传达）

PC14.en: Aged officials in Tang court robes kneeling in a row on a boat deck, heads lowered, hands raised in petition, mist over the water behind, medium wide shot, photorealistic, cinematic.

LS21.en: An emperor alone on a vast throne dais in an enormous empty palace hall, sunlight pooling on empty floor, the scale of the room dwarfing the man, austere and lonely, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS21.beat: 太极殿上只有关中巴掌大的地盘

PC16.en: Close-up of a vermilion brush laying a decisive stroke across a silk decree on a low table, ink dark and wet, seal stone beside it, cold noon light, overhead shot, photorealistic, cinematic.
PC16.beat: 绢帛上“诸军并受秦王处分”

PD01.en: Bright noon sun across a Tang palace courtyard of pale flagstones, long hard shadows, empty and silent, faint dark marks on the stone, wide still shot, photorealistic, cinematic.
PD01.beat: 正午日光下的太极宫，血水凝涸

PD02.en: A Tang official register scroll lying open, a vermilion brush crossing out line after line of names, ink drying dark, cold light on paper, overhead close-up, photorealistic, cinematic.
PD02.beat: 绝杀令下达，宗室名册被朱笔勾去

PD03.en: A silent corridor in a Tang palace side hall, doors standing ajar with no one in them, small shoes and wooden toys left on the threshold, long shadows, wide restrained shot, photorealistic, cinematic. (empty scene, no people)
PD03.beat: 空荡的别院回廊：门槛上留下的小鞋与木玩具（留白，不出现孩童）

PD04.en: Close-up of a clan genealogy roll with a whole branch struck through in vermilion, paper fraying at the edge, ink bleeding slightly, cold light, photorealistic, cinematic.

PD05.en: An open Tang dynasty official history volume on a dark desk, four characters standing alone on the page, lamplight raking across the paper, deep shadow around, close-up, photorealistic, cinematic.
PD05.beat: 《旧唐书》上冰冷四字“宗室绝嗣”

LS10.en: A powerful aristocratic clan head in formal dark silk seated in an ancestral hall, banners of the Eight Pillars of Northern Zhou behind him, stern composed face, incense smoke, symmetrical imposing composition, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS10.beat: 李渊真面目：北周八柱国、陇西李氏大当家

PD07.en: A son in Tang court robes kneeling on a palace floor, forehead pressed to his father's knee, the old man's hand resting motionless on the armrest, silent hall, slanting noon light, wide solemn shot, photorealistic, cinematic.

PD08.en: Close-up of a man's shoulders shaking in silent grief, face hidden against a father's knee, ornate silk robes pooled on polished floor, hard shadows, photorealistic, cinematic.
PD08.beat: 铁血王者双膝跪地，深埋痛哭

PD09.en: Two silhouettes in a vast Tang throne hall: an old man seated, a son kneeling before him, the space between them wide and cold, light from a high window, symmetrical wide shot, photorealistic, cinematic.
PD09.beat: 父子剪影：愧疚，还是政治释怀？

PD10.en: A column of cold museum light falling on excavated soil at an archaeological pit edge, tools laid aside, dust suspended in the beam, night-dark surroundings, medium shot, photorealistic, cinematic.
PD10.beat: 一千三百年后，考古射灯下的泥土

PD11.en: A small weathered limestone epitaph tablet standing under a single cold spotlight in darkness, dense vertical brushwork carved deep, cracks running across the face, close-up, photorealistic, cinematic.
PD11.beat: 五十六字墓志铭，短得难以置信

PD12.en: Extreme close-up of one carved character on an ancient stone tablet showing clear re-cutting: the original strokes scraped flat and a new character carved over the ghost of it, raking light revealing the scar, photorealistic, cinematic.
PD12.beat: “隐”字的刮改痕迹：原字被磨去重刻

PD13.en: A single carved Chinese character on stone under a narrow beam of light, surrounding surface worn smooth, dust and age in the grain, extreme close-up with deep shadow, photorealistic, cinematic.
PD13.beat: 一字之改，千古帝王的心虚

PD14.en: A full limestone epitaph tablet standing alone in darkness under cold museum light, columns of small carved characters, the stone scarred and cracked, wide solemn framing, photorealistic, cinematic.
PD14.beat: 五十六个刻字，烙印在盛世源头

PD15.en: A Tang dynasty accession ceremony on the great steps of a palace hall, emperor in dark ceremonial robes ascending, ministers ranked below in colored robes, banners raised, clear dawn light, wide formal shot, photorealistic, cinematic.

PD16.en: A wide view of early Tang dynasty Chang'an at dawn: tiled rooftops stretching to the walls, market lanes beginning to stir, mist thinning, warm first light on eaves, high wide shot, photorealistic, cinematic.
PD16.beat: 贞观初年长安，宏图初展

PD17.en: A vast column of steppe cavalry in fur and lamellar armor moving across open plains toward a distant river bridge, dust cloud trailing far behind, cold grey sky, wide epic shot, photorealistic, cinematic.
PD17.beat: 突厥二十万铁骑压境，渭水便桥
